description: Ensemble of N maxout nets; FGSM ensemble-targeted vs single-member-targeted. Headline metric = error of the ensemble's mean-prob prediction (SPEC §6 item 11).

hyperparams.single_member_arm: attack each member, average ensemble error

note: Sub-scale run (members=4, epochs=3, patience=10). The paper's 91.1/87.9% use 12 fully-converged nets. direction REVERSED at sub-scale (single-targeted > ensemble-targeted); both errors saturate near 100% with few undertrained members -- the paper's 91.1>87.9 direction needs 12 converged nets.

paper_target.quote: error rate of 91.1% on adversarial examples designed to perturb the entire ensemble ... falls to 87.9%
